item.description: Decline blamed on AI and social media but was triggered much earlier by austerity reforms and budget cuts.

item.title: UN upholds housing as a human right on World Habitat Day
item.description: Representatives from governments, civil society and academia meeting in Muscat, Oman on Monday called for urgent action to address a global housing crisis affecting nearly 3.4 billion people.

item.title: Sudan: Driver killed in aerial attack on aid trucks in South Kordofan
item.description: The World Food Programme (WFP) has strongly condemned a deadly airstrike on two clearly marked aid trucks in South Kordofan, Sudan, this past weekend.

item.title: Extreme heat making pregnancy a ‘new fault line’ in climate crisis
item.description: Pregnancy and childbirth have become a “new fault line in the global climate crisis” as extreme heat worsens, the head of the UN climate action body (UNFCCC) warned on Monday, calling for maternal and newborn health to be built into countries’ climate plans.

item.title: ICC unseals four arrest warrants over Taliban persecution of women and girls
item.description: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has made public four arrest warrants against senior Taliban figures, accusing them of persecuting women and girls in Afghanistan, which amounts to a crime against humanity.
